title: Berry Banana Smoothie
description: A thick, fruity smoothie of frozen berries, banana, yogurt and a little honey. Five minutes and a blender is all it takes.

image.alt: Two glasses of purple berry smoothie with berries and banana

ingredients.note: frozen in chunks for a thicker smoothie

steps.text: Pour the milk into the blender first, then add the yogurt, banana, berries and honey. Liquid at the bottom helps the blades catch.
Blend on low for a few seconds, then on high until completely smooth, about {time 1 min notimer}. If it’s too thick to move, add a splash more milk.
Taste and add a little more honey if your fruit is tart, then pour into glasses and serve right away.

notes: For a vegan smoothie, use plant milk, a plant-based yogurt and maple syrup instead of honey.
Freeze ripe bananas peeled and in chunks so they’re ready for smoothies.
